description: Rename a checklist and/or change its position among the task's checklists. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated checklist.

checklist_id.description: ID of the checklist to edit.

name.description: New name for the checklist. Omit to keep the current name.

position.description: 0-based position of the checklist among the task's checklists (0 = first).

name: edit_checklist
